findings.evidence: The checkout contains only `StandardTableau/Basic.lean` and `StandardTableau/Reading.lean`; `rg` finds no module preserving `TauCeti.Combinatorics.Young.StandardTableau`.
findings.fix: Retain `StandardTableau.lean` as a forwarding module that publicly imports `StandardTableau.Basic`.
findings.issue: Moving the module without a compatibility shim breaks downstream imports of the existing public path.

findings.evidence: Line 54 applies `@[expose]` to the whole section; the three definitions occur at lines 66, 135, and 159, with characteristic lemmas at lines 71, 152, and 165.
findings.fix: Use `public section` without `@[expose]`; keep downstream reasoning through `readingIndex_def`, `rowReading_apply_val`, and `colReading_apply_val`.
findings.issue: `@[expose] public section` exposes the bodies of `readingIndex`, `rowReading`, and `colReading`, making consumers depend on implementation details even though their application/definition lemmas are provided.

summary: The PR breaks the existing import path and unnecessarily exposes every new definition body despite providing characteristic lemmas.
